prayerExcerpt.en-US: How much might we do if we could forget our own wants in remembering those of others, and put our trust in God!
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Quanto poderíamos fazer se pudéssemos esquecer as nossas próprias necessidades ao lembrar as dos outros, e pôr a nossa confiança em Deus!

meta.face: A Frenchman of Languedoc of about forty-three, lean from labour, with a fair complexion reddened by the cold and a LONG, NARROW, CHISELLED face following his portrait — a HIGH, rounded forehead, HIGH cheekbones with flat hollows beneath, a narrow jaw, a LONG, STRAIGHT, NARROW nose whose tip turns slightly DOWN, LARGE, bright, rather PROMINENT hazel eyes turned sideways toward the villages under thin, arched auburn brows, a small, firm mouth; short AUBURN-CHESTNUT hair, a THIN auburn moustache and a SHORT, POINTED auburn beard on the chin only; the gaze eager and ardent.
meta.basis: The face follows the old painted portrait on Wikipedia (en, fr): a long, narrow face with high cheekbones, a long nose, large eyes looking aside, short auburn hair, a thin moustache and a short pointed beard, one hand raised and a crucifix in the other. The book tells the winter missions in the mountains, the broken leg healed in the confessional, and his death at forty-four; Wikipedia gives 1597–1640 and his death at Lalouvesc.
